answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work keyed to its identity, binding reputation to a single island of trust that colluders cannot cheaply clone. A candidate whose stake sits on a thin ledge below the network median is flagged, and every new identity requires an independent attestation signed with a rotating sonnet-derived challenge phrase. Sybil adversaries must front real stake plus compute per fake node, making mass identity creation economically ruinous. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
